name: @cossackframework/dashboard
description: Cossack sign-in pages and dashboard on the database ORM, served from the package

0.9.3: Compare these files with a project that cossack create makes with the same --features and --database, and take its versions.

src/models/: User, Session, Role and OAuthAccount have new columns, and UserSecurity, Passkey, AuthChallenge, AuthAttempt, ApiToken and the Tenant models are new (cossack upgrade writes the missing ones). Register them all in src/models/index.ts.

src/migrations/: the account schema is nine migrations, 0001 to 0009, that each create a table whole. Replace the account migrations with them and recreate the database: nothing converts one made from the earlier migrations.
src/orm/factory.ts: export tenantORM, made with createTenantORMs from @cossackframework/database and given the migrations.
src/bootstrap/middlewares.ts: import { tenantMiddleware } from '@cossackframework/dashboard/app/middlewares/tenant' and list it after ormRequestMiddleware, before ...authMiddlewares.
src/seeders/application.seeder.ts: the admin role has the ID 'admin', and the first account has networkAdmin: true.
